title: What rails and foundations are needed for a 100-tonne weldment stress-relieving furnace?
summary: Heavy-bogie loading checks extend from workpiece supports through wheels, rails and foundations. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s gas-furnace proposal dated 14 February 2023 is for post-weld stress relief of large weldments, with a 100 t load definition, wheel-pair equalising frames and QU80 rails. Equalisation is intended to accommodate uneven loading and fabrication/installation tolerances; it does not replace checks of actual supports, wheel loads and rail installation.
